title: Senior Blockchain Developer / Protocol Engineer
description: Senior blockchain developer and protocol architect responsible for: multi-chain and cross-chain system design (EVM, TVM, Solana, bridges, interoperability); deep security engineering (Echidna property testing, Manticore symbolic execution, MythX, full pre-audit security reviews); ZK Rollup architecture and proof system understanding (zkSNARKs, zkSTARKs, zkEVM types); Ethereum 2.0 validator infrastructure; non-EVM chain development (Rust/Anchor for Solana, FunC/Tact for TON); Ethereum roadmap evaluation (Danksharding, EIP-4844, Verge/Purge); and oracle network selection and security design.

skills.rationale: Leading full security pipelines (Slither + Echidna + MythX + Manticore), performing threat modeling for novel DeFi protocols, and driving pre-audit engineering reviews — security leadership is the defining senior characteristic.

Evaluating L1/L2/L3 architecture trade-offs, understanding ZK proof circuits, advising on rollup selection (Optimistic vs ZK), and tracking Ethereum's Danksharding roadmap for infrastructure planning.

Multi-chain architecture design spanning EVM, TVM, and Solana ecosystems; cross-chain bridge security evaluation; and interoperability protocol selection (LayerZero, CCIP, IBC) with explicit risk analysis.

Full-depth Solidity mastery including Yul assembly optimization, complex upgrade architectures (Diamond EIP-2535), Rust for Solana/Substrate, production monitoring stacks, and governance-controlled upgrade flows.
Architecting multi-layer dApp systems (custom indexers, API layers, client node infrastructure), building novel DeFi primitives, and operating production validator or archive node infrastructure.

Designing oracle security strategies: evaluating Chainlink vs Pyth vs API3 for specific use-cases, mitigating flash loan price manipulation, implementing oracle circuit breakers, and auditing oracle dependencies in DeFi protocols.
Protocol-level reasoning about consensus safety thresholds, fork migration strategies, replay attack mitigation during hard forks, and cryptographic primitive security assumptions.
Navigating legacy Brownie/Truffle codebases, making framework selection decisions for new protocols, and contributing to or evaluating toolchain choices for engineering teams.
At senior level, fundamentals are assumed and applied at strategic depth — advising on blockchain adoption decisions, designing systems with explicit trilemma trade-off reasoning.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in security engineering, scaling architecture, or cross-chain system design — cannot lead protocol-level decisions.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Strong mid-level blockchain engineer; building depth in security tooling, ZK rollup architecture, and cross-chain bridge design.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Leads protocol development teams, conducts pre-audit security reviews, deploys on multiple L2s, and is developing ZK proof and multi-chain bridge expertise.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all senior expectations: leads security-first protocol engineering, architects cross-chain systems, evaluates scaling solutions, operates validator infrastructure, and mentors mid-level engineers.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds senior expectations: Principal/Staff Protocol Engineer impact — contributes to EIPs, designs novel ZK circuits, leads cross-protocol security research, or architects multi-chain protocol standards.
